summary: Validated 4 new capabilities (two-way chat, callback request, callback dealer placement, recording playback) plus regression. Backend: 26/26 pytest tests pass (added TestChatThread, TestCallback, TestRecordings — 8 new tests covering customer→dealer chat visibility, dealer→customer chat visibility, empty-text 400, callback creation + timeline note + dealer list, dealer place → status placed + timeline note, missing-phone 400, recordings list after placing a call, 404 friendly detail when no recording, attach recording_url and re-play returns url). Frontend: Dealer console at /dealer (JWT in localStorage) — Amazon Connect tab renders CallbacksPanel (data-testid callbacks-panel) with pending callback rows, callback-place-CB-... button places call, toast 'Callback placed' fires and row flips to 'placed'. Opening a queue incident detail renders RecordingList (data-testid recordings-section, 'No voice calls on this incident yet.' when empty) and ChatThread (chat-thread/chat-input/chat-send-btn); dealer message posts and appears immediately (verified 'Dealer UI test msg' in DOM). Customer dashboard at /dashboard (session cookie) — opening an incident shows Request a Callback (callback-phone-input + request-callback-btn) — submitting fires toast 'Callback requested — the dealer team will call you back' AND timeline gets both 'Customer requested a callback on +1-555-0199 — queued for the dealer team' and (once dealer placed it) 'Callback CB-34CFC3 placed to +1-555-0199 by Service Manager'. Customer Live Chat sends 'Customer UI test hello' and it appears in the thread. Two-way chat verified via API (customer msg visible in dealer list, dealer msg visible in customer list, and per-incident isolation confirmed).
critical_code_review_comments: ChatThread polls every 5s with setInterval but uses eslint-disable-next-line for deps; if incidentId changes the interval is cleared/rebuilt correctly, but the load closure captures 'base' from the previous render — currently safe because base is derived from incidentId, but consider adding [incidentId, role] to deps for clarity.

RecordingList: pressing Play on a recording with no URL/key surfaces backend detail 'Recording not available yet. It appears once the call ends and Amazon Connect syncs it to S3.' via toast — matches the spec 'friendly not available yet toast'. Good UX.
Callback endpoint returns 200 with pending status in simulation; consider returning 202 to signal deferred processing (cosmetic).
server.request_callback pushes a timeline event but doesn't touch updated_at on the incident; other dealer patches do — minor consistency issue for auditing.
ChatThread displays sender bubble alignment based on role vs sender; 'system' notes are centered — good. Consider adding aria-live='polite' on chat-thread for accessibility.

CallbacksPanel polls every 8s. When a callback is placed via UI it reloads immediately (good), but the panel does not deduplicate by id if two intervals fire in flight; the setItems replaces wholesale so effectively fine.
